title: Publish queue and recovery health

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Processing health projection tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_processing_health_projection.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#queue-and-recovery-health-projection RED: no owner projection exposes exact current queue and recovery facts; GREEN: a controlled mixed-state population returns exact pending/processing/ready/no_faces/failed counts, oldest pending acceptance time, current operation/start and worker/recovery values without history or writes; decisive comparison: direct row reconciliation matches every field and repeated reads are stable; artifact: isolated query projection and cleanup output.
purpose: Publish the processing-owned direct queue, current-operation and recovery projection used by inventory health views.
success_outcome: For one SPA/serving revision the projection returns exact state counts, oldest pending time and current worker/recovery facts from persisted state without a second metrics model.
anti_goals: Do not implement HTTP/UI, SLO classification, capacity observation, materialized counters, history or another monitoring store.
Do not hide processing failures based on inventory visibility.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The required current projection cannot be derived directly from owned persisted state.
Truthful health would require history, materialization or another observability service.

constraints: Use direct PostgreSQL reads for one SPA and selected serving revision.
Use task-unique rows, controlled timestamps, safe rerun and owner-bounded cleanup.
Expose only bounded safe failure/current-operation values.
invariants: All five state counts are current processing truth.
oldest_pending_accepted_at derives from owner-supplied admission facts and is nullable.
The projection does not write state or create history/materialized counters.
verification_targets: Controlled mixed-state/recovery fixture reconciles counts, oldest pending, operation/start and worker/recovery singleton values exactly.
